note: This file is a pure Python-style configuration file for MMDetection instance segmentation on COCO. It contains no callable functions, classes, or methods — only variable assignments, imports, and config dict updates. No CLI-invocable code exists.
configure_train_pipeline: configure the training data pipeline with multiscale random resize and random flip for COCO instance segmentation
configure_test_pipeline: configure the test data pipeline with fixed resize and annotation loading for COCO evaluation
configure_train_dataloader: configure the train dataloader with RepeatDataset, AspectRatioBatchSampler, and batch size 2 for COCO training
configure_val_dataloader: configure the validation dataloader with CocoDataset and test mode for COCO val2017 evaluation
configure_optimizer_and_scheduler: configure SGD optimizer with lr 0.02 and MultiStepLR scheduler with milestones at epochs 9 and 11
